title_landing: Novelo: textile collection, designed at the lowest cost
landing_description: Novelo designs Guimarães's separate textile collection network at the lowest cost: budget and target in, comparable scenarios out in euros, tonnes and €/t.
landing_lead: Budget and target go in; comparable scenarios come out in euros, tonnes and €/t for Guimarães' collection network.
landing_lead_short: Budget and target go in; comparable scenarios come out in euros, tonnes and €/t.
landing_register_note: New accounts must be approved by an administrator. You get an email when your request is accepted.
landing_hero_caption: Three threads almost closed around a point. The gap at the top says the cycle is not closed yet, and that is where Novelo works.
landing_stat_rate_source: Calculated from Vitrus and INE data
landing_problem_title: Less than a quarter of the potential reaches separate collection.
landing_problem_lead: 301.3 t are collected per year, but the estimated potential is about 1,317 t (0.7 kg per inhabitant per month × 156,830 inhabitants, INE).
landing_benchmark_label: kg per inhabitant per year: Guimarães (2025) and France (2024).
landing_benchmark_source: Guimarães: our calculation on Vitrus and INE data. France: Refashion, via press (secondary source, to be verified).
landing_how_title: From budget to scenario in three steps.
landing_how_lead: No loose spreadsheets: the same model, the same data and the source of every number.
landing_how_1_title: Set the budget and the target
landing_how_1_text: You say how much you can spend per year and how many tonnes you want to capture, with the constraints you know.
landing_how_2_text: It chooses where and how to collect in each parish (CP-SAT) and plans the vehicle routes (VRP). The result is reproducible.
landing_how_3_text: Scenarios side by side in euros, tonnes and €/t, with uncertainty in sight and the origin of every value.
landing_features_title: From bag to thread, in one place.
landing_features_lead: Each step feeds the next: plan the network, decide, follow every batch to industry and report.
landing_feat_simulator_text: Budget and target go in; the lowest-cost network and collection routes come out.
landing_feat_scenarios_text: Save scenarios and compare them side by side, with uncertainty and robustness.
landing_feat_triage_text: A photo of the label gives the item's composition and state. The operator confirms.
landing_feat_lots_text: Every batch has a public page with origin, composition, weight and history.
landing_feat_exchange_text: Batches grouped by fibre for recyclers: composition and weight at a glance, reserved in one click.
landing_feat_report_text: One click generates the dossier with costs by territory, collected material, method and sources.
landing_copilot_title: Ask in Portuguese. Get a calculated scenario.
landing_copilot_lead: The copilot understands "What if...?" and returns the optimiser's result, not an opinion.
landing_copilot_point_1: The model only turns the question into a structured change. It never does the maths.
landing_copilot_point_2: Every number comes from the optimiser or the database; a verifier rejects any that do not exist.
landing_copilot_point_3: Actions only go ahead with your click and are logged.

landing_chat_answer: Understood: in Serzedelo, remove street containers and use on-demand collection. I will recalculate the scenario and compare investment, annual cost, tonnes and €/t.
landing_data_title: Real data, with the origin in plain sight.
landing_data_lead: The map brings together parishes, localities and municipal layers. Each source says what it is and what is still missing.
landing_data_vitrus_text: Textiles collected by 4 entities, circuits, vehicles and localities.
landing_data_ine_text: Population by municipality and parish, the basis of demand.
landing_data_municipal_text: {containers} municipal containers in {places} locations. They are not textile containers: they serve as candidate sites, producers and parish geometry.
landing_data_textile_text: Still to be received from Vitrus. They are never mixed with the municipal containers.
landing_impact_title: Today's network and where the collected textiles go.
landing_impact_lead: The simulator's starting point: the network that exists and where collected textiles end up.
landing_audience_title: Made for those who decide, operate and recycle.
landing_aud_council_text: They compare scenarios, defend the budget and prepare the 2028 EPR dossier with the municipality's own numbers.
landing_aud_ops_text: They plan routes, run photo triage and follow every batch from the collection point to industry.
landing_aud_recyclers_text: They browse the fibre exchange, see composition and weight per batch and reserve what suits them.
landing_faq_a1: A decision tool that designs Guimarães' separate textile collection network at the lowest cost. It was born in the TexVitrus Challenge 5 of Hack4Guimarães 2035.
landing_faq_a2: The starting ones come from Vitrus Ambiente (2025) and INE. Whatever was not measured carries the "estimate" label and every assumption has a source.
landing_faq_q3: Does the AI do the maths?
landing_faq_a3: No. Every number comes from the optimiser or the database, and a verifier rejects any number that is not in the source result.
landing_faq_q4: What happens to the triage photos?
landing_faq_a4: Only the brand, composition and weight are kept. Photos are deleted after processing and there is never any data about who handed in the item.
landing_faq_a5: Yes, to use the app. New accounts are approved by an administrator and you get an email when your request is accepted.
landing_faq_q6: Are the textile containers on the map yet?
landing_faq_a6: Not yet: the locations are still to be received from Vitrus. The {count} municipal containers have arrived, but they are not textile containers and are not mixed with the textile network.

landing_method_title: How Novelo decides, step by step.
landing_method_lead: Measured data calibrate demand, an optimiser picks the network, and every scenario comes out in euros, tonnes and €/t.
landing_pipe_label: Novelo pipeline: data, demand, optimiser, scenarios and Copilot with verifier
landing_fig_1_caption: From data to scenario. Each arrow is a reproducible step; the Copilot does no arithmetic and a verifier checks every number.
landing_method_calibration: Calibration: street containers serve 80% of the population (assumption) and the rate for those served is 22.9% ÷ 80% = 28.6%. A street-only network therefore reproduces the 301 t Vitrus collects today.
landing_proof_title: Before spending a euro, see what each target demands.
landing_proof_lead: Drag the yearly capture target. These are direct calculations on real data, done in your browser: no optimiser, no AI, no account.
landing_sim_zone_now: Starting point: what Vitrus collects today.
landing_sim_zone_model: Within the model's reachable limit (estimate): a network is possible; the cost depends on the budget.
landing_sim_zone_above: Above the model limit: with current assumptions the minimum-cost scenario would be infeasible (as with the French benchmark). Only a pilot can measure higher capture rates.
landing_sim_zone_cap: Above the estimated potential: there is not enough textile to capture.
landing_sim_note: These calculations use no costs: Vitrus unit costs have not arrived yet, so €/t is under validation.
landing_fig_2_caption: The target against real milestones: what is collected today, the model limit, the French benchmark (to be verified) and the potential (estimate).
landing_fan_title: Cost per tonne with €60,000 a year
landing_fan_caption: Fig. 3 · The central case and the P10 to P90 range of 500 Monte Carlo samples (seed 7). Estimate, with the assumptions of the time: the biggest source of uncertainty is the 0.7 kg per inhabitant per month.

landing_rigor_lead: What we measure, what we estimate and what we do not yet know, stated plainly.
landing_rigor_verifier_text: The model never does arithmetic: every number in the text must exist in the optimiser or database result. If it does not, the answer is rejected and rewritten.
landing_rigor_repro_text: Fixed seeds and a solver time limit; Monte Carlo uses 500 samples with seed 7. The same request gives the same scenario.
landing_rigor_prov_text: Every number has a source or is marked as an assumption. What was not measured carries the label "estimate".
landing_not_1: It does not replace the council's decision: it compares scenarios and shows the uncertainty.
landing_not_2: It does not let the AI do arithmetic or act alone: actions only go ahead with your click.
landing_not_3: It does not mix municipal containers with the textile network.
landing_not_4: It does not invent costs: without Vitrus unit costs, €/t is an estimate.
landing_limit_1: Vitrus unit costs and the location of textile containers have not arrived yet.
landing_limit_2: The 0.7 kg per inhabitant per month comes from the municipal plan and we do not know exactly what it includes: it is the biggest source of uncertainty.
landing_limit_3: Distances are straight-line with a 1.3 factor; there is no road routing engine yet.
landing_limit_4: Photo triage has not yet been evaluated with ground-truth images.
landing_limit_5: For four parishes density cannot be computed for lack of a usable outline.
